subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: What canonical public Gateway activity and attention contract should OpenClaw expose for per-session busy, waiting, stale-run, and child-session state?
rationale: This defines public Gateway RPC/event semantics and session-state ownership, while current code only has coarse active-run projections and the open PRs disagree on scope.

options.title: Approve a canonical activity contract
options.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundaries, stale-run handling, child rollup, authorization, docs, and tests before merging implementation work.

options.title: Narrow to UI/status slices
options.body: Let narrower blocked/stale or Control UI progress work proceed while keeping the broader activity contract open.

options.title: Defer the public surface
options.body: Keep existing diagnostics and `hasActiveRun` signals until maintainers are ready to own a broader Gateway API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a canonical activity contract
recommendation.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundaries, stale-run handling, child rollup, authorization, docs, and tests before merging implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live issue assignee and has recent Gateway/protocol-adjacent history.
